description: This file defines the AesDecryptingStream class, which implements streaming decryption of data encrypted with AES, utilizing the AWS SDK's cryptography components. It provides methods for decryption, stream management, and cipher info retrieval.

classes.name: AesDecryptingStream
classes.description: Implements a decrypting data stream for AES-encrypted data, supporting decryption, seeking (rewinding), and size retrieval, designed for use within AWS SDK's cryptographic workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new decrypting stream instance with the given ciphertext stream, key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name corresponding to the cipher method.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns a name identifier for the AES cipher.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector used for decryption.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the decrypted plaintext, or null if unknown due to padding.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream supports writing; always false for this stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and decrypts a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets the stream to the beginning; throws exception if seeking elsewhere.

methods.name: decryptBlock
methods.description: Reads and decrypts a block of ciphertext, managing padding options.
